name: SlButton
description: Themed wrapper around headless SlButton. Same behavioral props plus variant, tone, size, block, and iconOnly. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written until SLO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button behavior, forwarded to the unstyled SlButton.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Forwards native disabled semantics to the unstyled SlButton.

props.name: loading
props.description: Forwards consumer-owned pending state to the unstyled SlButton.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment. The default omits data-variant so CSS can treat a missing hook as solid.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color intent, independent of variant. The default omits data-tone.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as md.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to the available inline size via data-block.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Square icon-button treatment via data-icon-only. Still requires an accessible name.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Button label and optional decorative content such as an icon. Icon-only use requires aria-label, aria-labelledby, or hidden text.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native button after mount; null before mount and after unmount. Delegates to the unstyled SlButton.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native button when it is mounted and enabled. Delegates to the unstyled SlButton.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native button when it is mounted. Delegates to the unstyled SlButton.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native button element inside the display:contents themed scope.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Optional decorative icon content inside the default slot.

parts.name: loading-indicator
parts.description: Optional decorative pending indicator. Replaces the default spinner when present.

states.name: loading
states.description: Pending action. Overlay spinner and wait cursor. Wins over disabled for data-state.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable appearance. Prefer the native disabled attribute when both apply.
